rows.note: Suspected the JDK's second-layer HTTPS endpoint identification (SNIHostName rejects a trailing dot) would refuse https://localhost.:<port>, which Proxy.to accepts (FR-PROXY-001 AC-2) and the proxy's own matcher matches; with trustCertificates(selfPem) and the resolver seam the request is reached (200 ok).
stripPrefix(true) with allowed percent-encodings (%20, %ED%95%9C) in the path: the url() remainder is raw, so the suffix guard passes and the backend receives GET /a%20b/%ED%95%9C?q=%41.
Same-origin Location values whose rewritten path starts with '/\' and with '/<TAB>/' both get the leading '/.' on a root mount.
A PEM text with CRLF line breaks, a BOM and text before and after the block is accepted by trustCertificates(String).
